title: The Apple Developer Program
module: Xcode 27 and the Apple Developer Program
chapter: Your Mac, Xcode and the Apple Developer Program
description:
You now know Swift. The rest of the course is about building apps with it, using the tools Apple gives developers. This lesson explains what you need, and what you get from the Apple Developer Program.

What is free

With nothing but a free Apple Account you can:

  • download Xcode and everything in it: the editor, the simulators, Instruments, the documentation;
  • build and run apps in the simulator for every Apple platform;
  • run your own apps on your own iPhone, iPad or Mac. Apps signed with a free account stop working after seven days and need rebuilding, and some capabilities are not available.

That is enough for most of this course.

What the membership adds

The Apple Developer Program costs US $99 a year (prices vary by country, and fee waivers exist for eligible non-profits, schools and government bodies). It adds everything you need to put apps in other people's hands:

You getWhat it is for
App Store distributionSell or give away apps on every Apple platform
TestFlightSend test builds to up to 10,000 testers before release
App Store ConnectManage your apps, pricing, reviews, sales and analytics
CapabilitiesiCloud and CloudKit, push notifications, in-app purchases, Apple Pay, Sign in with Apple, App Groups and more
Developer IDSign and notarize Mac apps you distribute yourself, outside the App Store
Xcode CloudBuild and test in the cloud on every change, with compute hours included
Beta softwareEarly access to new versions of iOS, macOS and Xcode
Code-level supportAsk Apple's engineers for help with a technical problem

Enrolling

You enrol as an individual (apps appear under your own name) or an organisation (apps appear under a company name, which needs a D-U-N-S number, a free business identifier). Enrol at developer.apple.com/programs or in the Apple Developer app, with an Apple Account that has two-factor authentication turned on.

Apple Developer Program You do not need to join yet. Chapter 9, where you ship an app, is the first place it is required. If you are already a member, everything in this course works with your account.

questions.question: What can you do with only a free Apple Account?

answers.text: Publish apps on the App Store
Build apps and run them in the simulator and on your own devices

questions.why: Distribution and several capabilities need the membership.

questions.question: You want to sell a Mac app from your own website, not the App Store. What do you need from the program?

answers.text: A Developer ID certificate, to sign and notarize the app
Nothing: Mac apps need no signing

questions.why: macOS trusts downloaded apps that are signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
